doc.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023

title: Letterman show: Renee Fleming and the overnight opera arrangements
summary: Paul Shaffer asked for thirteen opera excerpts overnight for Renee Fleming's Top 10; Malone arranged and transposed on the spot.

blocks.x: Well as far as I know, Finale is more the standard for the publishing business. And although Sibelius has some advantages too, and I have both of those softwares, but there’s always a deadline when I do an arrangement so I just always go back to Overture because I’m lightening fast on that. One night — I was arranger for the David Letterman show for 22 years. One night, we did — our basic schedule was we did the show from 4:30 to 5:30 PM and then it was broadcast at 11:30. Anyway, one night — the show’s over around 5:30, 5:35. I go upstairs and I’m changing clothes and I’m almost out of the building and, “Can you meet with Paul in Paul’s dressing room?” Okay so Paul has two CDs in his hand. He says, “Renee Fleming’s going to do the Top 10 tomorrow. We need thirteen opera excerpts by eleven in the morning. And here’s the thirteen opera excerpts. He gives me a CD. And the other CD, this is Renee Fleming’s most recent recording album product, figure out what key she should sing them in.”

You’re supposed to have a rehearsal with the piano and the vocalist before you do this. Anyway so that part was left out. And then Paul looks at me with a panic look on his face and he says, “Bones, how are we going to pull this off?” I said, “I’ll play flute, Aaron (our sax player) will play oboe, we’ll hire a French horn, we’ll hire a clarinet, and you’ll

play the string parts on the string synthesizer. There’s your opera.” And we’ve all heard opera. We know, we can —.” So I stayed up all night, did all the stuff, and all night while I was staying up I was thinking to myself Renee Fleming has got to be a real diva. She’s going to be difficult. It turns out to be exactly the opposite. She had a great sense of humor, very easy to work with, just nicest person ever. And I had one of the songs in the wrong key. I brought my laptop with me, quickly transposed all the parts and printed it out in Paul’s office next door. Five minutes later there it is. And it’s on YouTube. Renee Fleming, David Letterman, Top 10.
